theme: Light Color Theme (Warm Slate & Emerald WCAG AA)

architecture.local_service: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 Authority & Express 127.0.0.1 IPC Bridge
architecture.renderer: React 19 / TypeScript 5 / Tailwind CSS v4 / TanStack Query (Light Theme)
architecture.persistence: SQLite 3 with AES-256-GCM and Win32 DPAPI Key Hierarchy

requirements.name: Untrusted Renderer & Authenticated Localhost IPC
requirements.evidence: Bearer token enforcement on loopback 127.0.0.1; DNS rebinding defense; renderer has zero direct OS execution privileges.

requirements.name: Consent-Based Onboarding & Local Enrollment
requirements.evidence: Interactive enrollment wizard in UI and /api/v1/enrollment endpoint with persistent token creation.

requirements.name: Console Lock & Device Owner Login Page
requirements.evidence: LoginPage component with PIN authentication, brute-force lockout, session validation, and shared-PC protection.

requirements.name: Protection Status Model (green/yellow/red/unknown)
requirements.evidence: Deterministic precedence engine implemented in /api/v1/status with sentence-level explanations in light theme.

requirements.name: Telemetry Adapters (Process, Network, Download, File, USB)
requirements.evidence: Verified synthetic telemetry adapter interfaces with explicit MOCKED / SAFE SIMULATION markers in Linux container sandbox.
requirements.unresolved_risks: Live Windows ETW/WFP requires physical Windows host with kernel permissions.

requirements.name: Versioned Detector Registry & Inert Synthetic Fixtures
requirements.evidence: Registry with versioned rules (LOLBin certutil, ransomware canary trip, phishing homograph) tested with inert synthetic fixtures.

requirements.name: Explainable Alert Detail, Timeline & Audit History
requirements.evidence: Alert detail drawer with plain English summaries, evidence tables, confidence rationales, and causal event replay.

requirements.name: Sensitive Action Preview, Authorization & Idempotency
requirements.evidence: Full state machine (preview -> await confirm -> authorize -> executing -> succeeded/failed) with idempotency cache and rollback support.

requirements.name: Offline Persistence, Retention, Export & Delete
requirements.evidence: SQLite schema documented in /docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA_AND_MIGRATION.md; export/delete API endpoints functional.
requirements.unresolved_risks: Win32 DPAPI requires native Windows host; fallback software derivation used in Linux sandbox.

requirements.name: Panic Flow with Honest Scope and Recovery
requirements.evidence: Network isolation with loopback preservation, impact warning dialog, and instant 1-click restore.

requirements.name: Accessible Desktop Console (Light Theme, WCAG AA, Scaling)
requirements.evidence: High contrast light surfaces (#f8fafc / #ffffff), paired text/icon semantics, high contrast focus rings, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation.

requirements.name: Performance Budgets & Release Artifacts
requirements.evidence: Simulation test harness confirms <2% idle CPU and alert delivery <300ms in sandbox; physical Windows hardware benchmark marked NOT VERIFIED.
requirements.unresolved_risks: Physical hardware profiling required on OEM Windows PC.
